content.text:
I removed the "Demo mode · scripted" badge and replaced the insurance form with a "Your connected insurance" card in the React app (`web/`). The build passes. I haven't looked at it in a browser, and nothing is committed.

- **Badge:** it's gone from the home screen (`web/src/pages/Home.jsx`), and I deleted the badge text from the English and Chinese strings in `web/src/i18n.js`.
- **Insurance card** (`web/src/components/InsuranceProfileForm.jsx`):
  - The collapsed header now reads **"Your connected insurance"**, with the saved insurer and plan below it, or "Add your insurer" if nothing is saved.
  - I removed "(optional)", the "Insurer" and "Plan" labels, and the "As shown on your policy" hint.
  - The two boxes are now just "Insurance company" and "Plan name". Screen readers still get a name for each box.
  - The small "Stored on this device only … never proof of cover" note stays. Pawse doesn't actually link to the insurer, so that note keeps "connected" honest under the project's no-false-claims rule.

⚠️ The two "Use backend agents · Simulated rehearsal" links are still on the home screen. Tell me if those should go too.

⚠️ The older `pawse/static/index.html` page still uses "As shown on your policy" as the hint in its insurer box. I left that page alone because your text matched the React app. I can change it to match if you want.
